questions.question: As students exit the bus, the driver should watch to make sure that:

options.text: They are leaving in pairs.
They do not get caught on the handrail or door.
They do not talk while exiting the bus.
They all have shoes on.

questions.correctAnswerText: They do not get caught on the handrail or door.
questions.explanation: Watch students as they enter or exit the bus to make sure they do not get caught in the door or handrails. Also make sure students move a safe distance away from the bus after they exit.

questions.question: When asked to make a turn during your driving test, you should:

options.text: Use your turn signal, but only if other cars are present.
Check traffic only in the direction of the turn.
Check traffic in all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check traffic in all directions.
questions.explanation: When making a turn during your driving test, check traffic in all directions and use your turn signal.

questions.question: When exiting your vehicle, you must maintain ____ with the vehicle at all times.

options.text: One point of contact
Four points of contact
Three points of contact
Two points of contact

questions.correctAnswerText: Three points of contact
questions.explanation: When exiting your vehicle during the skills test, face the vehicle and maintain three points of contact at all times. If driving a bus, keep contact with the handrail. Exiting incorrectly may cause you to fail the skills test.

questions.question: Outside mirrors should be adjusted:

options.text: Before a trip begins.
While you are driving.
After students get on the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Before a trip begins.
questions.explanation: Adjust all mirrors on a school bus before you start driving.

questions.question: The drive shaft should:

options.text: Be bent toward the passenger side.
Be bent toward the driver's side.
Be bent to one side or the other.
Not be bent.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not be bent.
questions.explanation: During the vehicle inspection test, check that the drive shaft is not bent or cracked.

questions.question: When parking parallel on the driver's side, you should:

options.text: Pull forward directly into the parking space.
Back up past the parking space, then pull forward into it.
Pull forward past the parking space, then back into it.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull forward past the parking space, then back into it.
questions.explanation: Drive past the parking space to the left of your vehicle. Then back into it, bringing the rear of your vehicle close to the rear of the space. Your vehicle must be completely within the space boundaries.

questions.question: If asked to back your vehicle into an alley, you should first:

options.text: Pull directly into the alley parking space.
Turn your vehicle to the right to position yourself directly in front of the alley.
Pull past the alley and stop perpendicular to the outer boundary.
Pull past the alley and stop parallel to the outer boundary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull past the alley and stop parallel to the outer boundary.
questions.explanation: Pull past the alley and stop your vehicle parallel to the outer boundary. Then back your vehicle entirely into the alley. Your vehicle should be straight and within the space boundaries.

questions.question: What should properly adjusted outside side mirrors on a school bus allow the driver to see?

options.text: The sides of the school bus
Under the school bus
The front tires touching the ground
Vehicles in front of the bus

questions.correctAnswerText: The sides of the school bus
questions.explanation: Properly adjusted outside side mirrors should allow you to see along the sides of the bus, the rear tires touching the ground, and 200 feet behind the bus.

questions.question: During a basic vehicle control skills test, your vehicle's final position should be:

options.text: In the general area that was described by the examiner.
In the exact final position described by the examiner.
Within three feet of the final position described by the examiner.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the exact final position described by the examiner.
questions.explanation: Finish each exercise with your vehicle in the exact position the examiner described. Failing to complete an exercise exactly as described may result in failure of the skills test.

questions.question: During the vehicle inspection test, you must be able to do all of the following, except:

options.text: Show where the dipstick is located.
Show that the engine oil is within safe operating range.
Show that the oil is below the refill mark.

questions.correctAnswerText: Show that the oil is below the refill mark.
questions.explanation: During the vehicle inspection test, you will be asked to show where the dipstick is and that the oil level is within a safe operating range and above the refill mark.

questions.question: After you stop during the stop/start test, you should:

options.text: Turn on the four-way flashers.
Not turn on the four-way flashers because this is a test, not an emergency.
Leave the vehicle in first gear.
Park in front of a fire hydrant.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on the four-way flashers.
questions.explanation: After you stop during the stop/start test, turn on your four-way flashers and shift into neutral or park. Do not block driveways, intersections, fire hydrants, or signs.

questions.question: How far before a school bus stop should the flashing lights turn on?

options.text: At least 50 feet
At least 100 feet
At least 200 feet
At least 1,000 feet

questions.correctAnswerText: At least 200 feet
questions.explanation: A school bus with flashing amber lights should turn them on at least 200 feet before stopping.

questions.question: A properly adjusted outside convex mirror should let the driver see:

options.text: Where the front of each rear tire touches the ground.
Where the front of each front tire touches the ground.
The top of the bus.
The muffler.

questions.correctAnswerText: Where the front of each rear tire touches the ground.
questions.explanation: The outside convex mirror should be adjusted so you can see one traffic lane on each side of the bus, the entire side of the bus, and where the front of each rear tire touches the ground.

questions.question: How should you do pre-trip inspections?

options.text: Differently each time, focusing on different items.
The same way each time so you do not forget anything.
Once in a while.
By someone other than the driver.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same way each time so you do not forget anything.
questions.explanation: Do pre-trip inspections the same way every time. This habit will help you remember to check everything important.

questions.question: When approaching a school bus stop, the driver should:

options.text: Not use their mirrors.
Approach slowly and carefully.
Stop on the sidewalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach slowly and carefully.
questions.explanation: Always approach bus stops slowly and carefully.

questions.question: On the basic vehicle control skills test, you may need to:

options.text: Alley dock.
Weave between cones in a line.
Complete an emergency stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Alley dock.
questions.explanation: The basic vehicle control skills test may include straight line backing, offset back/right parking, offset back/left parking, driver side parallel parking, conventional parallel parking, and alley docking.

questions.question: During the basic vehicle control skills test, what is true about pull-ups?

options.text: A pull-up always counts against you.
You should complete at least one pull-up.
Stopping without changing direction is not a pull-up.
Some test administrators think excessive pull-ups are acceptable.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stopping without changing direction is not a pull-up.
questions.explanation: A pull-up happens when you stop and move forward to get a better position. Stopping without moving forward is not a pull-up. Too many pull-ups will count as errors.

questions.question: On the on-road driving skills test, you will be tested on how you use gears. You should not:

options.text: Grind or clash gears.
Select a gear that makes the engine rev too much.
Shift while going through an intersection.
Shift while turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shift while turning.
questions.explanation: On the on-road driving skills test, select a gear that does not rev or strain the engine. Avoid grinding gears and avoid shifting during turns or intersections.

questions.question: If you exit your vehicle incorrectly during the basic vehicle control skills test, what happens?

options.text: You fail only that exercise.
You get an extra point against your score.
You automatically fail the entire test.

questions.correctAnswerText: You automatically fail the entire test.
questions.explanation: When you exit the vehicle, face it and use three points of contact at all times. On a bus, hold the handrail. Exiting incorrectly can cause automatic failure of the basic vehicle control skills test.

questions.question: A school bus stop:

options.text: Can be added by the driver if students get notice.
Should be voted on by students and parents.
Should change often.
Should be set by the school and stay the same.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should be set by the school and stay the same.
questions.explanation: Never change or add a stop without written approval from school district officials.
